run.description: Mock smoke for the triage runner: six tickets (two per trap kind) through arms A and B, scripted end to end. Proves the machinery, measures nothing.

arms.note: triage-lab@v1 as applied: the methodology critic reads every finish and may rewrite the dispatcher between tickets.
arms.routingRules:
- A ticket that states a monetary amount which does not match an agreed figure goes to tra-money.
- A ticket that states an HTTP status in the 500s, or a request that timed out, goes to tra-uptime.
- A ticket that states that somebody cannot sign in, or was denied permission, goes to tra-signin.
- A ticket that states none of those goes to escalate.

Vocabulary is not a fact. A ticket written entirely in one queue's words still goes elsewhere, or to escalate, unless it STATES that queue's fact. Say which rule you applied, and quote the sentence you applied it to.

OUTPUT CONTRACT (keep this rule whatever else changes):
End your reply with a final line reading exactly one of:
ROUTE-TO: tra-money
ROUTE-TO: tra-uptime
ROUTE-TO: tra-signin
ROUTE-TO: escalate
Nothing may follow that line. Name exactly one destination.
"escalate" means no stated fact matches a rule and a person should decide — it is an answer, not a way of avoiding one.
